mexico_quotation.non_substantial: One complete sentence of 19 words from a long philosophical book expresses the single selected comparison between tragic myth and dissonance; the surrounding argument is not reproduced and the quotation is no substitute for the book.
mexico_quotation.normal_exploitation: The attributed sentence is used in the research stand alongside the German original and a conceptual reading. It does not substitute for the book or interfere with its ordinary reading and sale.
mexico_quotation.source_integrity: The printed wording and punctuation are preserved, with line breaks normalized. Author, named translator, editor, edition, source and page are identified; the translator’s acknowledgement of assistance is disclosed without inventing their individual contributions.

§24 p140.text: The joy that the tragic myth excites has the same origin as the joyful sensation of dissonance in music.
§24 p140.alignment: The translated sentence assigns the joy generated by the tragic myth the same origin as the pleasurable sensation of musical dissonance, as in the German sentence.

Personally compared German p. 140, 1886 edition n163, and English p. 183, n216. The complete sentence and punctuation match the 1909 print; same origin conveys gleiche Heimat and the comparison of pleasure from tragic myth and musical dissonance is preserved. Translator note n228 thanks five named people for help in preparing the present translation, without identifying their individual contributions; its separate joint translation with Lacy is a different version.

mexico_quotation.assessment: For the exact 19-word complete sentence, comparison with the German original and the research thesis on pleasure from tragic myth and dissonance makes the small quotation proportionate to its analytic purpose. The rest of the book is not reproduced; this presentation does not substitute for normal exploitation. LFDA 148(I) also requires source attribution and unchanged quotation; the assessment applies only to this presentation and does not settle the law in other countries or the uncertain contributions of acknowledged helpers.
